title: Zero-free regions inspired by work of Heath-Brown
summary: We prove a new explicit zero-free region for the Riemann zeta-function, drawing substantially on Heath-Brown's seminal work on Linnik's constant. Using these ideas we are able to prove that $ζ(σ+ it)\ne 0$ whenever $t\geq 3$ and $σ\geq 1- 1/(4.896\log t)$.
